{{Top|leg}}
'''Sei'lya''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Sei'lya was present on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] when their [[clan]] was assaulted by a rival clan using a reprogrammed [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] that deployed [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|Seekers]]. The Seekers slammed into the building's defenses and detonated. Sei'lya related on the entry for the droid that there was only circumstantial evidence that a rival clan was involved, and requested that anyone with evidence of who was behind the attack contact them at [[Margath's on Elshandruu Pica]]. The Bothan was offering a reward for any reliable information.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
